method: Direct inspection of final actual-mesh CPU views, isolated-part contact sheet, original-photo crop and source comparison.

views.name: assembled-waterfront
views.findings: Complete repeated shoreline; terminal posts close both back ends and stair shoulders. Native floor level and bear scale preserved. Front planting/building omitted.

views.name: pier-and-stairs
views.findings: Stair shoulders use terminal-post pieces, containing rail endings. Coping returns, actual tread tops and native landing are visible. Cropped bear framing is deliberate; stairs are an explicit game adaptation.

views.name: tile-catalogue
views.findings: Nine isolated actual-mesh views; all labels and dimensional captions fit. Concave water notch, mirrored terminal returns and full stair projection are readable.

limitations: Main Horticultural Building, planting and boats are outside this shoreline kit.
CPU diffuse lighting and source base colours; native bear paint shader omitted.
Water/land fill are preview-only; water line0.92 m is an art choice.
Corners, terminal returns and stairs are game adaptations; no surveyed historic dimensions claimed.
Catalogue intake, collision/traversal and WebGL review remain separate.

sourceComparison.findings: Source crop and actual assembly compared; preserved forms and grid adaptations are plainly separated. Perspective source is not used as a measured elevation.
